title: Dong Gonzales posts P270k bail for 3 counts of graft over alleged conflict of interest
summary: Former Pampanga 3rd District Rep. Aurelio "Dong" Gonzales has posted P270,000 bail for all three counts of graft over alleged conflict of interest involving infrastructure projects.
